description:
Search 19 additional tools that are loaded on demand. Send one keyword query per capability you need; returns matching tool names and descriptions. Then `tool_describe` loads schemas and `tool_call` invokes. Tools already in your tool list need no search. `connectors__` names are tools of the user's app accounts (Gmail, Linear, ...); `manage_connections` checks or authorizes an account.

Every tool listed below exists: never call it unavailable, and go straight to `tool_describe` when you see the exact name.
